title: 2010 Part A
text:
Dear Joe,

I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to you for your warm hospitality when I participated in an exchange program in USA.

Your generosity helped to make my stay in USA a memorable memory and gave me a good chance to know American culture better.
Besides, I think it is really an honor for me to make friends with you and I will cherish the friendship forever.
I do hope that you will come to China one day, so that I could have the opportunity to repay your kindness and refresh our friendship.

Please allow me to give my sincere appreciation to you again.
And wish to see you in China soon.

Sincerely yours,

Zhang Wei
textTranslate:
亲爱的乔：

我在美国参加交流项目期间，您热情周到的款待令我十分感激，谨此向您致以我最诚挚的谢意。

您的慷慨让我在美国的这段时光成为难忘的回忆，也让我有机会更好地了解美国文化。
此外，我认为能与您结交实在荣幸，我会永远珍惜这份友谊。
我由衷希望您有朝一日能来中国，让我有机会回报您的好意，重温我们的友谊。

请允许我再次向您表达诚挚的谢意。
期待不久能在中国的相见。

您真诚的，

张伟

title: 2010 Part B
text:
This bar chart shows mobile phone subscriptions in developing countries and developed countries, measured in billions, for the year of 2000 to 2008.
The mobile phone subscriptions in both developing countries and developed countries enjoyed increase in different speed over time.
In this chart, the mobile phone subscriptions in developed countries maintained a continual and steady increase from 2000 to 2007 and remained constant in 2008.
Meanwhile, the mobile phone subscriptions in developing countries have undergone a slow increase from 2000 to 2004 and then saw a great surge from 2005 to 2007.
This trend increased to a peak about 4 billion in 2008.

Based on different national situations, the reasons leading to this trend can be summarized into two points.
First, the developed countries have a limited number of population, which decides that the demand for mobile phone service is also limited and will soon be saturated.
Second, as for the developing countries, it has a large population and also a large demand for mobile phone service.
And as the mobile phone becomes more available and more affordable, there is an increasing number of people buying their mobile phones.

In my view, this trend that the number of mobile phone subscription continues to grow in developing countries will be constant for a while in the future.
And this trend would also benefit most of the mobile users both in the developing countries and developed countries.
textTranslate:
该柱状图展示了2000年至2008年发展中国家与发达国家的手机订阅量（单位：十亿）。
发展中国家与发达国家的手机订阅量均随时间的推移以不同速度增长。
在这幅图中，发达国家的手机订阅量在2000年至2007年间持续稳定增长，2008年保持平稳。
与此同时，发展中国家的手机订阅量在2000年至2004年间缓慢增长，随后在2005年至2007年间大幅激增。
该趋势在2008年达到约40亿的峰值。

基于各国国情的不同，导致这一趋势的原因可归纳为两点。
第一，发达国家人口数量有限，这决定了其手机服务需求也有限，并将很快趋于饱和。
第二，就发展中国家而言，其人口众多，对手机服务的需求同样巨大。
而且随着手机越来越普及、越来越买得起，购买手机的人正不断增加。

在我看来，发展中国家手机订阅量持续增长这一趋势在未来一段时间内将保持稳定。
这一趋势也将使发展中国家和发达国家的多数手机用户受益。

title: 2011 Part A
text:
Dear Li Ming,

I heard that you had been admitted to a university.
First, congratulations.
I can well imagine how proud your parents are now, since they have been anxiously hope to witness your success.
And then, I would like to give you some suggestions about your preparations for university life.

To begin with, you should set up your own goals about what you want to learn at the university and what you want to be after four years of learning.
Then, based on your goals, you'd better start reading some books about your major and be familiar with your major.
It helps you enter a better condition early.
Last but not least, you should get used to an independent life soon.
You have to cultivate an independent living style.
The earlier you rely on yourself, the more quickly you can get a self-motivated university life.

That's all my suggestions.
Hope you have a worthy summer holiday and enjoy yourself.

Sincerely yours,

Zhang Wei
textTranslate:
亲爱的李明：

我听说你已经被一所大学录取了。
首先，恭喜你。
我完全能想象你父母现在多么自豪，因为他们一直急切地盼望着见证你的成功。
接下来，我想就你为大学生活所做的准备给你一些建议。

首先，你应当为自己设定目标，想清楚大学期间想学什么、四年之后想成为什么样的人。
其次，在这些目标的基础上，你最好开始读一些与你专业相关的书籍，熟悉你的专业。
这有助于你更早进入良好状态。
最后但同样重要的是，你应当尽快适应独立生活。
你必须培养独立的生活方式。
你越早依靠自己，就能越快拥有自主积极的大学生活。

以上就是我的全部建议。
祝你度过一个有意义的暑假，玩得开心。

您真诚的，

张伟

title: 2011 Part B
text:
This bar chart shows the market shares of three different types of brand cars in domestic automobile market between 2008 and 2009.
In 2008, Japanese brands cars took the lead in the automobile market, accounting for 35%, followed by Chinese brand cars, with 25% market shares.
American brand cars fell behind, with merely 12% market shares.
In 2009, Chinese brand cars saw a mild increase in their market shares, which came to 33%, while Japanese brand cars lost a lot of their market shares, taking up only 25%.
American brand cars stayed almost the same position, occupying 13% market shares.

It could be concluded that more and more people choose to buy Chinese cars instead of buying the foreign brand cars.
In the past, Japanese cars dominated the Chinese car market because of the comparably low price and low oil consumption.
While, as our Chinese car industry has grown to be maturer and maturer, we could also produce cars with high performance, low price, and beautiful look.
However, it cannot be neglected that the gap is not so obvious and if Chinese brand automakers want to make a big difference, they have to make more efforts.
textTranslate:
该柱状图展示了2008年至2009年国内汽车市场上三类不同品牌汽车的市场份额。
2008年，日系品牌汽车在汽车市场居于领先地位，占35%，紧随其后的是中国品牌汽车，市场份额为25%。
美国品牌汽车则落后，仅占12%的市场份额。
2009年，中国品牌汽车的市场份额小幅上升至33%，而日系品牌汽车失去了大量市场份额，仅占25%。
美国品牌汽车则几乎保持原状，占据13%的市场份额。

由此可以得出结论：越来越多的人选择购买国产汽车，而非外国品牌汽车。
过去，日本汽车凭借相对低廉的价格和较低的油耗主导了中国汽车市场。
然而，随着我国汽车工业日益成熟，我们也能生产出性能高、价格低、外观美的汽车。
不过，不可忽视的是差距并不十分明显，中国品牌车企若想取得重大突破，还须付出更多努力。

title: 2012 Part A
text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to make a complaint against your product quality.
I bought an electronic dictionary from your online store last week but I found something wrong with its quality when I first used it.
So I am writing this letter to complain against the flaws in your product.

To begin with, when I turn it on, all I got was a fuzzy screen, which was completely unacceptable.
Secondly, I did not find the original equipment battery promised free of charge in the advertisement posted on the homepage of your shop.

Therefore, I would like to either change the electronic dictionary for a new one or receive a refund for it.
I would be most grateful for your help.

Sincerely,

Zhang Wei
textTranslate:
尊敬的先生或女士：

我写此信是为了投诉贵方产品的质量问题。
我上周在贵网店购买了一台电子词典，但第一次使用时便发现其质量有问题。
因此我写这封信，投诉贵方产品存在的缺陷。

首先，当我开机时，看到的只是模糊的屏幕，这完全无法接受。
其次，我并未在贵店首页广告所承诺的范围内找到免费赠送的原装电池。

因此，我希望要么更换一台新的电子词典，要么获得退款。
若您能给予帮助，我将不胜感激。

真诚的，

张伟

title: 2012 Part B
text:
This table illustrates the difference of degree of satisfaction among employees at different ages in some company.
In general, the overall trend of the degree of satisfaction is different with the variation of ages.
Of those who feel satisfactory about their jobs, those beyond 50 years old take up the majority, accounting for 40%, followed by those who are no more than 40 years old, which takes up 16.7%.
Those between 41 to 50 years old have the lowest satisfactory rate, merely 0.0%.
Of those who feel dissatisfactory about their jobs, those between 41 to 50 years old take up the majority, accounting for 64.0%.

The contributory factors to this result can mainly divide into three parts.
Firstly, those less than 40 years old are ambitious, impractical and eager to find their places in work.
With those characteristics, they often get upset when they fail to fulfill their goals.
Secondly, those between 41 to 50 years old employees, confronted with challenges posed by their young colleagues, often face a great deal of working competition and pressure.
Lastly, with their impending retirement, those beyond 50 years old face relatively small working pressure and feel satisfactory about their jobs.

From this table, we can make a conclusion that if the companies want to raise the degree of satisfaction of its employees, it should make more efforts to improve the working environment, ameliorate the welfare and establish the effective incentive mechanism.
textTranslate:
该表格说明了某公司不同年龄段员工满意度的差异。
总体而言，满意度的总体趋势随年龄变化而不同。
在对自己工作感到满意的员工中，50岁以上者占多数，达40%，其次是40岁及以下者，占16.7%。
41至50岁者的满意度最低，仅为0.0%。
而在对工作感到不满意的员工中，41至50岁者占多数，达64.0%。

造成这一结果的原因大致可分为三部分。
首先，40岁以下的人雄心勃勃、不切实际，急于在工作中找到自己的位置。
带着这些特点，他们往往在未能实现目标时感到沮丧。
其次，41至50岁的员工面对年轻同事带来的挑战，常常承受着大量工作竞争与压力。
最后，随着退休临近，50岁以上者面临的工作压力相对较小，因而对自己的工作感到满意。

由该表我们可以得出结论：企业若想提高员工满意度，就应更加努力改善工作环境、完善福利并建立有效的激励机制。

title: 2013 Part A
text:
Dear Fellow Students,

Our class is going to hold a charity sale for the kids in need of help on Sep 15th, 2013.
As the host of this event, I sincerely hope that all of you can participate in.

One thing you can do for the kids is to contribute the things that you don't need as many as possible for the sale.
All the profit we make is going straight to the kids immediately.
We would need some help at the sale to set up the tables and chairs as well.

There is a famous Chinese saying which inspired us to hold this event: "Gifts of roses, hand there are lingering fragrance." I am positive that you won't regret to donate your strength to help the kids.

Yours,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的同学们：

我们班将于2013年9月15日为需要帮助的孩子们举办一场慈善义卖。
作为本次活动的组织者，我衷心希望大家都能够参与其中。

你能为孩子们做的一件事，就是尽可能多地把闲置物品捐出来用于义卖。
我们所得的全部收益都会立即交给孩子们。
此外，义卖当天我们还需要一些人手帮忙摆放桌椅。

有一句中国名言激励我们举办了这次活动：“赠人玫瑰，手有余香。”我相信，你不会后悔献出自己的力量去帮助这些孩子。

你的，

李明

title: 2013 Part B
text:
The statistics of students taking part-time jobs in a certain university has been clearly revealed by the column chart.
There has been a steady increase from 67.77% to 71.93% for students holding temporary jobs from freshmen to juniors according to the survey, while the percentage of seniors working part-time jumped to 88.24%.

Part-time job has the potential negative affect to college students' studies while it can also be a good force for their academic careers.
Becoming a drain on the their time is the most obvious way that having a part-time job can adversely affect students' studies.
Reducing the perceived incentive to study is another way that part time employment can be detrimental to students.
There are also some potential benefits offered despite presenting certain pitfalls by working part-time during one's college years.
For example, it can help students to understand their preferences better or to try out a possible career path.
In addition, companies seeking to recruit recent grads will give preference to those with real-world experience.

In conclusion, the student's ability to maintain focus and balance his or her own time decides the impact of a part-time job on student's academic career.
The job is certain to yield a positive impact, if students are able to effectively manage their time and secure a part-time position in a field related to their studies or interests.
textTranslate:
柱状图清晰地揭示了某大学学生从事兼职工作的统计数据。
调查显示，从大一到大三，从事临时工作的学生比例从67.77%稳步上升到71.93%，而大四学生从事兼职的比例则跃升至88.24%。

兼职工作可能对大学生学业产生负面影响，同时也可能成为其学业的助力。
占用时间，是兼职对学生学业产生不利影响最明显的方式。
削弱学习动力，是兼职可能对学生有害的另一方面。
尽管大学期间做兼职存在某些弊端，但也会带来一些潜在益处。
例如，它能帮助学生更好地了解自己的偏好，或尝试一条可能的职业道路。
此外，招聘应届毕业生的公司会优先考虑那些具有实际工作经验的人。

总之，学生保持专注并平衡好自己时间的能力，决定了兼职对其学业的影响。
如果学生能够有效管理时间，并找到一份与所学专业或兴趣相关的兼职，那么这份工作必定会产生积极影响。

title: 2014 Part A
text:
Dear John,

I am so happy to know that we will be roommates in Harvard University.
My name is Li Ming, a Chinese girl, living in the North Part of China.
Today I am writing this letter on the purpose of telling you some Chinese habits in order to reach a warm gathering in the next 2 years.

4 years' living in university, I have developed a habit that get up at 7 a.m.
and go to bed at 10 p.m.
And as we know,sleeping is very important to us.
Thus, I hope you can understand me and tell me whether you can keep this time.

Also, please kindly give me some advice about living there.
Your early reply will be appreciated.
Thank you!

Yours,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的约翰：

得知我们将成为哈佛大学的室友，我非常高兴。
我叫李明，是一个来自中国北方的女孩。
今天我写这封信，是想告诉你一些中国人的生活习惯，以便我们在未来两年里相处融洽。

大学四年住校期间，我养成了早上7点起床的习惯。
晚上10点就寝。
而且众所周知，睡眠对我们非常重要。
因此，希望你能理解，并告诉我你是否能保持这个作息时间。

另外，请就那里的生活给我一些建议。
期待你的早日回复，不胜感激。
谢谢！

你的，

李明

title: 2014 Part B
text:
What is shown in the picture tells us that a trend has taken place in the past 20 years in China.
According to the figures given in the bar chart, the population in cities had a sharp rise from 300 million to 666 million.
In contrast, the population in rural area decreased from 834 million to 674 million In 2010.
each of then almost shared half of the total population.
What can account for this change?

Obviously, some driving reasons that lead to the above tendency may be summarized as follows.
First of all, with the development of economy, more people would like to choose to go to cities for a more comfortable and convenient life.
In addition, cities can offer more work opportunities.
In order to have more chances to improve themselves, more people are willing to leave their hometown to pursue her career.
Last but not least, their attitude towards living and working have a great change, compare with that 20 years ago.

Along with the advancement of our society, the trend is bound to continue for the coming years.
textTranslate:
图中所示告诉我们，过去20年间中国发生了一种趋势。
根据柱状图给出的数据，城市人口从3亿急剧上升到6.66亿。
相比之下，农村人口到2010年从8.34亿下降到6.74亿。
那时两者几乎各占总人口的一半。
这一变化说明了什么？

显然，导致上述趋势的一些驱动原因可归纳如下。
首先，随着经济发展，越来越多的人愿意选择去城市，以获得更舒适便利的生活。
此外，城市能提供更多工作机会。
为了有更多提升自己的机会，更多人愿意离开家乡去追求自己的事业。
最后但同样重要的是，与20年前相比，人们的生活与工作态度发生了巨大变化。

随着社会的进步，这一趋势在未来若干年必将持续。

title: 2015 Part A
text:
NOTICE

In order to improve the environmental awareness of high school students,the university is going host a nature education summer camp for high school students from 14 July to 28 July on Sheshan Mountain, Shanghai.

In the camp, students will be led by teachers in field trip to learn about plants, birds and local animals living on the mountain, work in teams to investigate on the local environmental status and hold workshops to find solutions to the environmental issues.

textTranslate:
通知

为提高高中生的环保意识，学校将于7月14日至28日在上海佘山为高中生举办一次自然教育夏令营。

行政办公室

2014年7月1日

title: 2015 Part B
text:
The chart shows that among the total expenditure of citizens during the Spring Festival, New Year's gifts account for 40% total, the highest percentage, while transportation, meals for reunion and others take up 20% respectively.

In Spring Festival, the most important festival in China, people usually use their annual saving generously for family and friends.
The chart reflects several deep-embedded traditions that have been inherited for thousands of years in Chinese culture.
Firstly, Chinese people attach great importance to inter-personal relationships.
Visiting, exchanging gifts and meals together are ways to tighten ties with each other.
That's why new year's gifts, transportation and meals for get-together are the top three expenditure in Spring Festival.
Secondly exchanging gifts with each other is a very Chinese-characteristic way to show care to each other in China, New year's gift take up 40% of the total expenditure.

To sum up, the sustained traditions of Spring Festival can be seen from the expenditure mix of Chinese people.
Anyway, it reflects people's wish to eat, play and be merry, but in an unique Chinese way.
textTranslate:
该图显示，在春节期间市民的总支出中，新年礼物占总额的40%，比例最高，而交通、团圆饭及其他各占20%。

春节是中国最重要的节日，人们通常慷慨地把一年积蓄用于家人和朋友。
该图反映了中华文化中传承千年的若干根深蒂固的传统。
首先，中国人极为重视人际关系。
走亲访友、互赠礼物和聚餐都是拉近彼此关系的方式。
这正是新年礼物、交通和团聚用餐成为春节前三大支出的原因。
其次，互赠礼物在中国是一种极具中国特色的相互关怀方式，新年礼物占到总支出的40%。

总而言之，从中国人的支出结构中可以看出春节延续至今的传统。
无论如何，它反映了人们吃好、玩好、快乐度日的愿望，只是以独特的方式呈现。

title: 2016 Part A
text:
Dear Jack,

Your letter of congratulations was received.
Thank you for your nice words on my winning the contest.
In the letter, you asked me about the skills to do translation, so the following are my advice for you.

Firstly, you should analyze the sentence structure, thus catching the meaning of the sentence.
Secondly, find the proper words to translate the meaning of the source language into the target language.
Thirdly, revise your translation at least three times to check if there are any mistranslations or missed meanings.

I hope my advice helpful.
Wish to see you soon.

Yours sincerely.

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的杰克：

你的祝贺信已收到。
谢谢你对我赢得比赛的祝贺。
信中你问及翻译的技巧，以下是我给你的建议。

首先，你应当分析句子结构，从而抓住句子的含义。
其次，找到恰当的词汇，把源语言的意思转换成目标语言。
第三，至少修改三遍译文，检查是否有误译或漏译。

希望我的建议对你有帮助。
期待早日见到你。

你真诚的。

李明

title: 2016 Part B
text:
Portrayed in the above pie chart is a survey of college students' purposes of traveling.
The number of students who take traveling as a chance to see beautiful scenes accounts for 37%, while students who would like to travel to relieve pressure from study take up 35 %.

There are several reasons behind the trend revealed in the above chart.
To begin with, as the present society is filled with fierce competition, most college students nowadays are under great pressure to stand out among others or to obtain a decent job after graduation, Therefore, they tend to choose traveling as an outlet to relieve their stress.
Secondly, with the fast advancement of the living standards of Chinese families, traveling is increasingly affordable to most college students.
For this reason, students prefer to travel to see different views to enjoy themselves or to make some friends.

From my perspective, no matter what reason it is for, traveling is of great benefit for students to broaden their horizon.
textTranslate:
上图饼状图展示的是一项关于大学生旅行目的的调查。
把旅行当作欣赏美景机会的学生占37%，而希望通过旅行缓解学习压力的学生占35%。

上图所揭示的趋势背后有几个原因。
首先，由于当今社会竞争激烈，如今大多数大学生都承受着巨大压力，希望脱颖而出或在毕业后获得一份体面的工作，因此他们倾向于选择旅行作为缓解压力的出口。
其次，随着中国家庭生活水平的快速提高，旅行对大多数大学生来说越来越负担得起。
正因如此，学生们更愿意通过旅行去欣赏不同风景以自娱，或结交一些朋友。

在我看来，无论出于何种原因，旅行都大有益于学生开阔眼界。

title: 2017 Part A
text:
Dear Professor Williams,

I feel really delighted and honored to be invited by you to give a presentation to the foreign students, and I will certainly be careful to prepare for the making of it.

To let the overseas students know much about our Chinese culture, I think that my presentation is supposed to include at least two key points.
On one hand, I will put much stress on the history of China.
You must know that our China is an ancient country with a pretty long history.
On the other hand, my second strong point should be put on the main diet in China.
The reason is that Chinese people in different regions have totally different inclination to choose food and Chinese food everywhere is quite delicious.

Those two points are what I would like to emphasize, and I would like to know of your opinions on this and I wish you could give me some further ideas on it.
I am looking forward to your reply.
Thank you.

Yours sincerely,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的威廉姆斯教授：

受邀为外国学生做一场报告，我深感荣幸与高兴，我一定会认真准备。

为了让海外学生更多地了解中国文化，我认为我的报告至少应包含两个要点。
一方面，我会着重讲中国的历史。
你一定知道，我们中国是一个历史悠久的古老国家。
另一方面，我的第二个重点应放在中国的主要饮食上。
原因在于，中国不同地区的人对食物的偏好完全不同，而且各地的中国菜都非常美味。

这两点正是我想强调的，我想了解你对此的看法，并希望你能就此给我一些进一步的意见。
期待你的回复。
谢谢。

您真诚的，

李明

title: 2017 Part B
text:
The chart shows great changes in the number of museums and their visitors during the period from 2013 to 2015.
According to the data given, what we cannot fail to see is that there is a sharp growth in the amount of museums from 4165 to 4697 over the period from 2013 to 2015, while it is also pronounced that the number of their visitors increased sharply from 637.8 million to 781.1 million during this period.

At least two fundamental factors could be identified to contribute to this phenomenon.
To begin with, it is widely admitted that with the rapid economic development in China, the whole social climate has been dramatically upgraded in living standard, which results in the common phenomenon that people in growing numbers can afford the once-deemed-expensive experience.
In addition, there is no denying that the authorities concerned have issued a series of preferential policies to protect and promote the development of cultural industry, which encourages a widespread extension of visitors.

From what has been discussed above, we may safely draw the conclusion that this trend will certainly maintain for quite a while in the near future, which will be of great benefits to our country and individual as well.
textTranslate:
该图展示了2013年至2015年间博物馆数量及其参观人数的巨大变化。
根据所给数据，我们不能不看到，2013年至2015年间博物馆数量从4165座大幅增长到4697座；同时，其参观人数也在此期间从6.378亿急剧增加到7.811亿。

至少可以找出两个根本因素来解释这一现象。
首先，人们普遍认为，随着中国经济的快速发展，整个社会的生活水平显著提升，从而出现了越来越多的人能够负担得起这种曾经被视为昂贵的体验这一普遍现象。
此外，不可否认，有关主管部门出台了一系列优惠政策来保护并促进文化产业的发展，这也带动了参观人数的普遍增加。

综上所述，我们可以有把握地得出结论：这一趋势在未来相当长一段时间内必将持续，并将对我国和个人都大有裨益。

title: 2018 Part A
text:
Dear Professor Smith,

I am writing to apologize for not being able to visit you this weekend since I have to cancel my travel plan to your city for my reason.

It so happened that I had an urgent phone call from Professor Jones on my way to the airport, who informed me that a crucial member of his research group would be absent for a week with a stomach flu and I would have to take his place after he left.
I know it very well that our appointment is of great importance.
Would you please be so kind as to give me another chance and change our appointment to sometime early next month?

I am really sorry for all the inconvenience brought to you.
Your early reply would be highly appreciated.

Yours sincerely,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的史密斯教授：

我写此信是为了致歉，因为个人原因，我必须取消前往您所在城市的行程，无法在本周末拜访您。

事情是这样的：我在去机场的路上接到了琼斯教授的紧急电话，他告知我他研究小组的一名关键成员因肠胃炎将缺席一周，我必须在他离开后接替他的工作。
我很清楚我们的约会非常重要。
能否请您行个方便，再给我一次机会，把我们的约会改到下个月初的某个时间？

给您带来不便，我深感抱歉。
若您能早日回复，我将不胜感激。

您真诚的，

李明

title: 2018 Part B
text:
The given pie chart clearly illustrates what consumers care about in selecting a restaurant for dinner in a certain city in 2017.
Specifically, the features of the restaurants account for the largest proportion(36.3%),while other unmentioned factors take up the least proportion(4.7%).
Then the service and the environment of the restaurants constitute 26.8% and 23.8% respectively.
Next comes the price, with only 8.4%.

Not surprisingly, nowadays the consumers pay more attention to the features of restaurants rather than the price of the dinner.
What has caused this phenomenon?
On the one hand, the rising in income boosts consumers' buying power, so lower price becomes less of a major advantage for restaurants in attracting customers.
On the other hand, with the development of economy, an increasing number of dining options are made available to customers, so more attention has been paid to the specialties of the restaurants.

To sum up, as people's living conditions have been significantly improved, this trend is likely to maintain for quite a long time in the future: the features of the restaurants, which is the taste of food, is always among the top of consumers' priority list.
textTranslate:
所给饼状图清晰地展示了2017年某市消费者在选择餐厅就餐时最看重什么。
具体来说，餐厅特色占比最大（36.3%），而其他未提及的因素占比最小（4.7%）。
其次，餐厅的服务和环境分别占26.8%和23.8%。
再次是价格，仅占8.4%。

毫不奇怪，如今消费者更关注餐厅的特色，而非就餐价格。
是什么造成了这一现象？
一方面，收入的增长提升了消费者的购买力，因此较低的价格不再是餐厅吸引顾客的主要优势。
另一方面，随着经济发展，可供顾客选择的就餐方式越来越多，因此人们更加关注餐厅的特色。

总之，随着人们生活条件的显著改善，这一趋势在未来很可能会持续相当长的时间：餐厅的特色，即食物的口味，始终位居消费者优先考虑之首。

title: 2019 Part A
text:
Dear Professor Smith,

I am exceedingly honored to hear the news that you ask me to plan the debate on the theme of city traffic.
Here, I am writing this letter for the purpose of suggesting a specific topic and telling you about my arrangements.

In order to have students have an in-depth understanding of the causes of city traffic, I suggest that the topic could be "Lack of management" VS "Lack of facilities", which can not only provide us with abundant knowledge about why the traffic problem is prevalent, but also equip us with the ability of thinking independently and critically.
In addition, the debate could be hold from nine o'clock to twelve o'clock on next Friday in the Lecture Hall of our library.

If you have any other ideas about this debate and its arrangement, please contact me in your convenience.
I am looking forward to your early reply.

Yours sincerely,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的史密斯教授：

得知您让我来策划以“城市交通”为主题的辩论赛，我深感荣幸。
在此，我写这封信是想建议一个具体的辩题，并向您说明我的安排。

为了让学生深入了解城市交通的成因，我建议辩题设为“管理缺失”对“设施不足”，这不仅能为我们提供关于交通问题为何普遍的丰富知识，还能培养我们独立、批判性思考的能力。
此外，辩论可定于下周五上午九点至十二点在我们图书馆的报告厅举行。

若您对本次辩论及其安排还有其他想法，方便时请与我联系。
期待您的早日回复。

您真诚的，

李明

title: 2019 Part B
text:
The bar chart given above reflects the changes of choices of graduates of a university in 2013 and 2018.
To be specific, the percentage for graduates seeking jobs decreases sharply from 68.1%, to 60.7%.
On the contrary, the proportion for graduates pursuing further study rises sharply from 26.3% to 34.0% and individuals creating their own business jumps from 1.3% to 2.6%.

It is of no difficult for us to come up with some possible factors to account for the trends.
To begin with, college students nowadays are facing fiercer competition in seeking and maintaining a job, so that some of them have to continue their learning or create their own business.
More significantly, with the economy booming and society advancing, the rapid growth of personal wealth has also laid a solid basis for them to afford a higher degree and achieve their self-realization.
More than anything, the department concerned at all levels in our country have released quite a few initiatives that privilege graduates to set up business.
Therefore, more students continue their study and start a business.

Taking into account what has been argued, we can come to the conclusion that the established trends are favorable and therefore acceptable.
And it is certain that they will continue in years to come.
textTranslate:
上图柱状图反映了某大学2013年与2018年毕业生去向的变动。
具体而言，求职毕业生的比例从68.1%急剧下降到60.7%。
相反，选择继续深造的毕业生比例从26.3%急剧上升到34.0%，自主创业者的比例则从1.3%跃升到2.6%。

我们不难想见一些可能的因素来解释这些趋势。
首先，如今大学生在求职和保持工作上竞争更加激烈，因此其中一些人不得不继续学业或自主创业。
更重要的是，随着经济繁荣和社会进步，个人财富的快速增长也为他们负担更高学历、实现自我价值奠定了坚实基础。
更重要的是，我国各级有关部门出台了不少惠及毕业生创业的举措。
因此，越来越多的学生选择继续深造或创业。

综合以上论述，我们可以得出结论：这些既定趋势是有利的，因而是可以接受的。
而且可以肯定，它们在未来数年内还会持续。

title: 2020 Part A
text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is Li Ming.
As a leader in students' union.
I am writing this letter to inform you that we are going to visit Forbidden city next week.

As you know, the forbidden city, which is also known as Palace museum, embodies this nations profound and diversified ancient culture with its magnificent architecture and precious treasures.
During this trip, it is advisable to pay closer attention to the tourist introduction of each site, which includes its origin, cultural background as well as translation in multiple languages.

I hope that you will enjoy the journey.
If you have any other questions, please do not feel free to contact me.

Yours,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
尊敬的先生或女士：

我是李明。
作为学生会的一名负责人。
我写这封信是想通知您，我们下周将去参观故宫。

如您所知，故宫又称故宫博物院，以其宏伟的建筑和珍贵的文物体现了这个民族博大精深、多元灿烂的古代文化。
此行中，建议多留意每个景点的讲解，其中包含其渊源、文化背景以及多种语言的翻译。

希望您旅途愉快。
若还有其他问题，请随时与我联系。

你的，

李明

title: 2020 Part B
text:
As is shown in the chart, it provides the information on the reading purpose of college students by mobile-phones in a certain university.
To be specific, the percentage of learning is 58%, which is biggest among the four categories.
Meanwhile, acquiring information account for 28%.
The former one is roughly 3 times as many as the latter one.
What account for this phenomenon?
Obviously, at least 3 factors contribute to it.

Initially, with the rapid development of science and technology, our smart phones become increasingly convenient for students to study.
Instead of taking numerous books in their bags, they prefer to put significant learning materials into their phone and then they can read them at anyplace they want.
In addition, it is no doubt that smart phone has become the necessary part in college students daily life, thus attracting an increasing number of students to enjoy themselves by their phones.
Finally, with people's living styles changing, students prefer to develop their social life on Internet and find more useful information to satisfy their academic needs.

Taking above reasons into consideration, we could firmly believe that the tendency will continue in the forthcoming years.
textTranslate:
如图所示，它提供了某大学大学生使用手机阅读目的的信息。
具体来说，以学习为目的的比例为58%，是四类中最大的。
与此同时，获取信息占28%。
前者约为后者的三倍。
是什么导致了这一现象？
显然，至少有三个因素促成了它。

首先，随着科学技术的快速发展，我们的智能手机对学生学习而言越来越方便。
与其把大量书籍装在书包里，他们更愿意把重要的学习资料存进手机，这样就能随时随地阅读。
此外，毫无疑问，智能手机已成为大学生日常生活中不可缺少的一部分，从而吸引越来越多的学生用手机自娱。
最后，随着人们生活方式的变化，学生更愿意在网上发展社交生活，并寻找更多有用信息以满足学业需求。

综合考虑上述原因，我们可以坚信这一趋势在未来几年将继续下去。

title: 2021 Part A
text:
Dear Jack,

Our class is going to plan an online meeting about how to improve students' physical health due to the COVID-19.
I am writing this email to invite you to take part in and tell you about the details of this meeting.

In the first place, the meeting will discuss the topic about how to prolong the time of outdoor activities and renew the sports facilities of our University.
In addition, we will also focus on diet, which is ignored by many classmates.
Finally, our meeting will be held at 7:00 pm next Friday on Zoom.
You cannot miss it.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
I am looking forward to your reply in the nearest future.
Happy New Year.

Yours,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的杰克：

受新冠疫情影响，我们班将筹划一次线上会议，讨论如何改善学生的身体健康。
我写这封邮件是想邀请你参加，并告知你这次会议的详情。

新年快乐。

你的，

李明

title: 2021 Part B
text:
As is illustrated in the bar chart, we can clearly see the trend of form of citizens' exercise in one city.
According to the data provided, we will observe that the percentage of citizens doing exercise alone ranks first, accounting for 54.3%.
While the item on community exercise is 15.8%.
The former is three times as much as the latter.
What can explain this phenomenon?
Obviously, the following factors are at play.

Initially, owing to the development and growth of our economy and society, an increasing number of citizens, especially those in big cities, have access to physical exercise and they can have enough time to do sports.
In addition, it is well believed that this trend is attributed to the government's favorable policies in sports.
Terminally, the changes in people's attitudes towards life, to some extent, also play an irreplaceable role.

Generally speaking, this tendency will continue in the coming years.
Our government and mass media are supposed to endeavor to promote the relationship with families and friends.
Only in this way can our society be relatively more harmonious and stable.
textTranslate:
如柱状图所示，我们可以清楚地看到某市市民锻炼形式的趋势。
根据所给数据，我们将观察到，独自锻炼的市民比例最高，占54.3%。
而社区锻炼一项为15.8%。
前者是后者的三倍。
什么能解释这一现象？
显然，以下因素在起作用。

首先，得益于我国经济与社会的发展与壮大，越来越多的市民，尤其是大城市的市民，有条件进行体育锻炼，并有足够时间运动。
此外，人们普遍认为这一趋势归功于政府在体育方面的利好政策。
最后，人们生活态度的转变在一定程度上也起着不可替代的作用。

总体而言，这一趋势在未来几年将继续。
我们的政府和大众媒体应当努力促进家人和朋友之间的关系。
唯有如此，我们的社会才能相对更加和谐稳定。

title: 2022 Part A
text:
Dear international students,

The campus food festival will be held on January 12th, 2022 in the second dining hall of our university.
As an important part of cultural exchange, the food festival is intended to enrich campus life and promote communication among students.
In the festival, you will enjoy numerous traditional Chinese food and snacks of different tastes, including hot pot, dumplings, roast duck, and so on.
And you will have chances to cook Chinese food by yourself.
By tasting and cooking such delicious Chinese food and snacks you will gain a deeper understanding of Chinese food and culture.

All the international students are welcomed to attend the food festival.
Looking forward to your arrival.

Sincerely yours,

Li Ming
textTranslate:
亲爱的国际学生们：

校园美食节将于2022年1月12日在我校第二食堂举行。
作为文化交流的重要组成部分，美食节旨在丰富校园生活、促进学生之间的交流。
美食节上，你将品尝到众多口味各异的中国传统美食和小吃，包括火锅、饺子、烤鸭等等。

期待你们的到来。

您真诚的，

李明

title: 2022 Part B
text:
The bar chart is about the growth of the package volume of express delivery industry between the year of 2018 and the year of 2020 in China.
To be specific, the number of express packages in the rural and total amount is 12 billion and 51 billion respectively in 2018, 15 billion and 64 billion respectively in 2019, and 30 billion and 83 billion respectively in 2020.

According to the statistics, we can see the express delivery industry witnessed a dramatic growth, especially in 2020.
As far as I can see, the growth in express delivery is partly due to the rapid development of the e-commerce industry and the further improved transport system, which makes it easy for both urban and rural people to shop online.
And advanced technologies, such as artificial intelligence, help improve the service of the delivery industry.
In addition, the outbreak of COVID-19 may also account for the increase of express delivery business, especially in 2020.
During the lockdown, people had to stay at home and bought most of their necessities online.

In view of the above analysis, I believe express delivery industry will boast a greater potential and embrace a brighter future.
textTranslate:
该柱状图反映的是2018年至2020年中国快递行业包裹量的增长。
具体来说，2018年农村与全国的快递包裹量分别为120亿件和510亿件，2019年分别为150亿件和640亿件，2020年分别为300亿件和830亿件。

根据统计数据，我们可以看到快递行业经历了急剧增长，尤其是在2020年。
在我看来，快递的增长部分归因于电子商务行业的快速发展以及交通系统的进一步完善，这使城乡居民网购都变得容易。
而人工智能等先进技术也有助于提升快递行业的服务水平。
此外，新冠疫情的暴发也可能是快递业务增长的原因，尤其在2020年。
在封控期间，人们不得不待在家中，大部分生活必需品都在网上购买。

综上所述，我相信快递行业将拥有更大的潜力，迎来更光明的未来。

title: 2023 Part A
text:

title: 2023 Part B
text:
The above line chart explicitly presents information about the health literacy level of the citizens in China from 2012 to 2021.
As is clearly illustrated in the graph, the share of health literacy ascended slightly from 8.8% to 11.58% from 2012 to 2016.
Meanwhile, the proportion increased greatly from 11.58% to 25.4% from 2016 to 2021.

Several factors, from my perspective, can be easily found to account for the phenomenon, among which I would like to name three most significant ones as follows.
In the first place, it is universally acknowledged that the relevant health departments has spared more efforts to advocate and encourage the public to pay attention to the physical and mental health.
In addition, there is no denying that with the rapid development of social media such as short videos, more and more residents can get more health tips online.
Last but not least, the sudden outbreak of COVID-19 in 2019 has been a wake-up call for many people, who began to focus on healthy and nutritious diet and do exercise, which is another significant factor that could not be ignored.

Taking all these factors into consideration, we can safely come to the conclusion that the current trend will continue for a while in the near future.
textTranslate:
上述折线图清晰地呈现了2012年至2021年中国公民健康素养水平的信息。
如图所示，2012年至2016年，健康素养的占比从8.8%小幅上升到11.58%。
与此同时，2016年至2021年，该比例从11.58%大幅增长到25.4%。

在我看来，不难发现若干因素可以解释这一现象，其中我想列举以下三个最重要的因素。
首先，人们普遍认为，相关卫生部门付出了更多努力来倡导并鼓励公众关注身心健康。
此外，不可否认，随着短视频等社交媒体的快速发展，越来越多的居民能在网上获取更多健康知识。
最后但同样重要的是，2019年新冠疫情的突然暴发给许多人敲响了警钟，他们开始注重健康营养的饮食并加强锻炼，这是另一个不容忽视的重要因素。

综合考虑所有这些因素，我们可以有把握地得出结论：当前这一趋势在未来一段时间内将继续。

title: 2024 Part A
text:
Dear Jack,

How are you doing recently?
I hope everything goes well.
To prepare the survey on the protection of old houses, here I put forward my plan as follows about how to do it.

To start with, what the survey includes are a host of projects like browsing the Internet for a basic acquaintance of old houses in the town and organizing a debate on protection countermeasures.
To continue, it is due to the importance and the meaning of the activity that I desire to call on Professor Green, who is a well-known expert in this field.

How about your suggestions?
l genuinely hope you can offer me some of your opinions at your earliest convenience.

Yours,

Li Ming

title: 2024 Part B
text:
Presented in the bar chart is a survey result of benefits of students' labor practice classes in a certain university.
To be specific, acquiring knowledge makes up the largest proportion, accounting for 91.3%, followed by raising labor abilities, obtaining cheerful moods and enhancing cooperative capabilities at 84.8%, 54.4% and 32.6% respectively.

Some factors may account for this tendency mentioned above.
For one thing, there exist an emerging body of individuals who tend to take part in labor practice classes, on the grounds that not only can it contribute to personal growth physically and emotionally but can promote community harmony.
For another, practical abilities are to college students what water is to fish.
In the absence of them, students would be refused by the challenging society, which helps explain why people prefer to do meaningful and valuable things.

Based on the analysis, we make the prediction that the phenomenon appears highly popular at present and will rise in continuity within the foreseeable future.
I am fully convinced that there will be a time when each student could make the best of their college time.
textTranslate:
该柱状图呈现的是某大学学生劳动实践课收获的调查结果。
具体来说，获取知识占比例最大，达91.3%，其次是提升劳动能力、获得愉悦心情和增强合作能力，分别为84.8%、54.4%和32.6%。

上述趋势可能由一些因素来解释。
一方面，有越来越多的人倾向于参加劳动实践课，理由是它不仅能促进个人身心成长，还能促进社区和谐。
另一方面，实践能力对大学生而言，正如水之于鱼。
缺少了它，学生就会被充满挑战的社会所拒绝，这也有助于解释为什么人们更愿意做有意义、有价值的事情。

基于以上分析，我们预测这一现象在当前非常普遍，并将在可预见的未来持续上升。
我完全相信，终有一天每位学生都能充分利用自己的大学时光。

title: 2025 Part B
text:
This is a column chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in the elderly's major leisure activities in a certain community.
To be specific, watching TV ranks the first, accounting for 90.8%, followed by walking, with 68.3%.
The next are watering flowers and reading, at 34.7% and 31.8% respectively.
Finally comes playing chess, with 18.4%.

Such figures, definitely, can be associated with elderly people's diverse lifestyles, but what resulted in these differences?
For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by its economic boom and prosperity, which has enabled an increasing number of families to possess additional income to purchase household appliances, including TV sets.
It is so many TV programs that enable senior citizens to just sit on sofas to enjoy fun.
For another, compared with youngsters, the elderly prefer activities which require less energy, like walking, reading and playing chess.

As a youngster, I deem that when I get elderly, I will choose to travel around the world, which can bring me opportunities to taste diverse delicious food, inspire my passion for life and help me enjoy my happy twilight.
textTranslate:
这是一幅柱状图，清晰地展示了某社区老年人主要休闲活动的鲜明对比。
具体来说，看电视排名第一，占90.8%，其次是散步，占68.3%。
接下来是浇花和阅读，分别占34.7%和31.8%。
最后是下棋，占18.4%。

这样的数据无疑与老年人多样的生活方式有关，但造成这些差异的原因是什么？
一方面，近年来中国经济繁荣昌盛，使越来越多的家庭拥有额外收入来购买包括电视机在内的家用电器。
正是如此多的电视节目，让老年人只需坐在沙发上就能享受乐趣。
另一方面，与年轻人相比，老年人更喜欢耗能较少的活动，如散步、阅读和下棋。

作为一名年轻人，我认为当我年老时，我会选择环游世界，这能带给我品尝各种美食的机会，点燃我对生活的热情，并帮助我享受幸福的晚年。
